items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: Nat Dominique and Charlie Alexander was playing at Kelley's Stables in Chicago, and Dodds knew I were kind of hard up and he laid off one night and had me to go in his place, play in his place.

ctx.x: Yes, I've got you there, yes.
That was Charlie Alexander and old Dominique.
Oh yes, that's right. Yes. And then he says, worked with Doc Cook and Dave Peyton at Café de Paris.
